Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.bluej

Class PackageTelemetryListener

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.bluej.PackageTelemetryListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
public class PackageTelemetryListener extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
Listens for BlueJ projects opening and closing. When a project opens it records the project folder, so the reports can be saved there, and takes a baseline of the classes already in it. Part of the Command pattern: this class is a client.
Author:
Anushka Dwarika
